business_problem: Challenging IT complexity and cost Boyner's Information Technology (IT) department is primary to the company's operations, ensuring that both internal systems and customer-facing services run smoothly.
solution_summary: Boyner used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Kubernetes Service to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. With enhanced data analytics, Boyner can now draw meaningful insights in 10 minutes instead of eight hours, helping to make informed decisions in real time.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Hosts scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving workloads in containers.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs integrated SQL and big-data analytics across enterprise datasets.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
